body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at The Address Sky View Tower 1, Emaar Square Area - Downtown Dubai.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Take your trip to Dubai to new limits with tickets to The Edge Walk! The Sky Views Edge Walk experience is strictly for the brave, as it lets you stroll hands-free along the ledge of the 53rd floor!
>
> Sky Views Edge Walk is the most thrilling attraction in Dubai, and the first of its kind in region. Welcome to the city’s highest full circle hands-free walk on a ledge that encircles the top of the Tower’s main pod, almost 220 metres above the ground!
>
> Soak up the sweeping views of Burj Khalifa while defying gravity. With no windows or other protective barriers between you and the views, this is taking thrill-seeking to extremes!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €142.29. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 79 ratings and 55 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
